documents.source: I&FC Flood Control Wing, Master Plan for storm water drainage of the MCD and DDA area (1976), Karol Bagh Zone; ifc.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/mcd.docx
documents.quote: The drain originates near the Shankar Road and flows through Rajinder nagar for a length of 800 metres, where it crosses the Pusa Road. Thereafter, it flows through Karol Bagh and Sarai Rohilla area for a length of 3000 metres and crosses Shankar Road. It then flows towards Shastri Nagar and Bharat Nagar areas and falls into the Najafgarh drain. The total length of a existing drain is 5700 metres and serves a catchment area of 3386 acres.

drains.name: Patel Road barrel (1976 plan), East Patel Nagar
drains.note: Alignment: the barrel runs along Patel Road for 2,000 m from the Pusa Road and Shankar Road crossing. Older source conflict: the 1976 plan lists it among MCD drains.
drains.owner_source: PWD road inventory RD-00798 'Patel Road' (West Road Division 2), Right of Way 36.57 m, 60 ft or more. GNCTD notification 10.01.2012 vests roads of 60 ft or more with PWD (PWD reply in NGT OA 559/2022); SDMC affidavit to the NGT, Feb 2020: drains on those roads are PWD's (South Delhi statement, applied here by inference)
